summary: FS page + rec.gov read. WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE lakefront -> lakeview: no RV site within ~50 m of the lakes over open ground - the east-side sites sit under continuous pine, the closest west-side pads (070, 028) are across willow thicket or marsh. $34 + $10 extra vehicle, 93 reservable sites (26-55 ft), 14-night max, season May 28 - Oct 10, 2027. Website and phone corrections below.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE lakefront -> lakeview (not --AWH). NHD waterbody + Esri imagery: west side, 070 (37.616374,-119.008774, 40 ft, unshaded) is ~30-34 m from the narrows between the lakes but across a willow thicket; 028 (37.615567,-119.009196, 30 ft) ~32 m across marsh meadow to the reedy north end of the lower lake, with no usable bank; 025/023 (30/36 ft) 43-47 m over the same marsh. East side, 001-007 and 010/011 (26-32 ft) are 33-55 m from the water under continuous lodgepole canopy (catalog shade 'Yes' at every one). The stored evidence point 37.6148,-119.0078 is the lower lake itself, and the 'pads along the isthmus shoreline' are the bridge road. Rec.gov's 'closer to the shore' and FS 'lake side camping' are marketing-level. Lake views are certain from both sections.
PHONE: 760-924-5500 is the Mammoth Lakes Welcome Center (FS page); the campground office run by the concessionaire is 760-934-5795 (rec.gov). Suggest 760-934-5795, or keep the FS number.
SITE COUNT: FS says 92, the rec.gov catalog lists 93; wrote 93.

FACILITIES: stored vault_toilets true (derived from old note prose) is not supported by the FS page or rec.gov, which name only flush toilets; left untouched for the reviewer. Showers are at the concession store, not the campground.
STATUS: the FS 'Site Closed' banner is the ordinary winter closure; 2027 reservations open by the 6-month window (May 28 already 'Open').
PIN: stored 37.61610,-119.00750 is between the two sections near the bridge; site centroid is about 37.6162,-119.0083 (~70 m). No move.
